value.rationale: The number of maximal one-dimensional lattice sections is a natural Ehrhart-type invariant whose leading coefficient is not necessarily fixed. This complete parametric exact law proves all minimal periods are possible even within primitive-sided centrally symmetric four-vertex polygons, with an unbounded factor-q oscillation of constituent slopes. Since the input uses O(log q) bits while a tabulated residue representation needs q entries, it gives a sharp qualitative representation limitation. These are motivated structural phenomena, not an arbitrary numeric slice; no broad lower bound for algorithms is claimed.
